records-needed-to-decide-the-proposal.text: Records needed to decide the proposal.
As a model reviewer, I want to see exactly what an identity or evidence record contains and which assertions are still hypothetical.

configuration-and-application-controls.text: The bound root Config contains the four policy pins plus root, minimum tip, processing/reclaim windows, registry identity, registration cost and booking width. The four-field proposal is not adopted by this plan. The investigation must account for each field and preserve every required economic obligation.

The bound application has a registry-parameterized App and protected Control fields. Changing that dependency requires a recorded comparison of controller update, genuine-token release and pending-custody behavior. This table specifies no replacement wire datum.

frozen-candidate-records.text: These records are hypotheses under the identity, role and hash questions, constrained by the complete-identity ruling. They define no ledger laws or wire migration. | Record | Fields or constructors | Scope | |---|---|---| | Payload | edge key owner destination nonce : Nat | Existing authorization tuple and booking nonce remain explicit. | | Role | state witness trieReady application | Four classification cases, discovered from compiled constructors. | | Binding | full nameOnly | Ruled complete binding and rejected name-only contrast. | | Reading | policyOnly authenticated | Unresolved recognition alternatives. | | Preimage | application release; statePolicy appPolicy; seed OutRef; role Role TokenId key; approval TokenId Payload | Tagged structural domains with complete identities. Name-only contrast replaces the policy component by zero. | | Observation | asset : TokenId, stateDatum : Bool, provenance : TokenId | Provenance is explicit authenticated-origin evidence with external validity still a premise. Fabricating a datum changes no asset or provenance. | | TxOutput | assets : List (TokenId × Nat) | Asset counts only; no fee or script semantics. | | TxView | spent : List OutRef, outputs : List TxOutput, mint : List (TokenId × Int), invoked : List Nat | Observation only; quantities sum per complete asset; history is a list of views. | | Guard | Full/name-only approval, policy-state, four authenticated roles, genesis seed count, history uniqueness | Selector is none or flip Guard; exactly one guard changes. | | Statement ledger | theorem, compiled statement digest, status, question/ruling, witness declarations, selectors, optional inversion case | Rejected readings have a separate status marker. | | Mutant ledger | theorem, selector, premise/positive/falsification declarations | Candidate and selector evaluate the same instance; no unrelated mutant function. | The minimal transaction view must later bind to accepted ledger/history vocabulary, as impact.md records. It cannot establish ledger validity, lineage, custody, supply or real hash collision freedom. Economic configuration and the termination custody ruling belong to subsequent stages.
